House of Isacco Lampronti

Site · Ferrara, Italy

Isaac Lampronti (1679–1756) was a prominent rabbi, physician, teacher, and Jewish scholar from Ferrara. He is best known for compiling Pachad Yitzchak, an influential encyclopedia of Jewish law and Talmudic scholarship. Lampronti was buried in Ferrara’s Jewish cemetery, but the exact location of his grave is unknown because grave markers were prohibited at the time and the cemetery was later damaged and looted. His memory is preserved in the city through plaques on his former home in Via Vignatagliata and a nearby square named after him.
